serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Mask? Really?
Bot: W-what? You don’t like my idea?
You: Are they really helping? I don’t see many people with them around.
Bot: They should help quite a bit. It said so on the producer's website.
…
You: Well, I guess we can try it out. How much is it?
Bot: Around 1200$.
You: W-what?! Are you crazy? Aren’t there any cheaper ones?
Bot: In the long run it will be cheaper. Think of it as an investment. Masks from Qizha Zui Corporation are said to be the best on the market and their self-cleaning properties make it so you can use them for a long period of time without changing filters.
Bot: Cost efficiency is really good, trust me! Using cheaper masks and replacing them every month would cost you more after 20 years.
She seems really invested in this whole air pollution deal, but it’s 1200$... {{wi}}Should I buy it?
